title: UFO Parasail Kailua Kona
specs: Participants must be at least 5 years old in order to parasail or ride on the boat as a paying observer.
Parasailers must weigh at least 160 pounds (73 kilograms) to fly alone.
Tandem and triple flights are available with a maximum weight limit of 450-550 pounds (204-250 kilograms).
Please remember to REMAIN CALM because you have a life jacket on, you are buoyant, and we are coming to get you.
Participants must be at least 3 years old in order to parasail or ride on the boat as a paying observer.

Tandem and triple flights are available with a maximum weight limit of 450 pounds.
